description: Use when you have a product's name, domain or kind in mind: send a short query ('stripe.com', 'postgres', 'invoicing') with filters for category, agent level, access or payment. Returns the products we drove, sorted by agent level (0-5), each with where our agent stopped; a task in plain words: choose_provider_for_task, one product in full: get_provider. Read-only, no key needed; up to 100 a page.

access.description: only products an agent gets into this way: signup_without_human (our agent signed up and got in without a person, any way), keyless (no key needed), local (runs locally), try_first (try first, claim later), pay_per_call, key_by_api, mcp_signin (our agent signed in to the product's own MCP server, by OAuth, and got in that way), email_signup, browser_signup, by_name (with a GitHub, Google or platform account), person (a person had to set it up: not counted)

agent_can_buy.description: true: only products our agent paid through an agent-native rail (x402, MPP and the like), proven by the payment

agent_can_leave.description: true: only products where our agent cancelled and deleted its account on its own

category.description: A category id or name from list_categories (e.g. 'crm'); an unknown one is an error that says so

limit.description: How many products a page holds, 1 to 100 (default 25)

min_level.description: Only products at this agent level or higher: 0 Read-only, 1 Needs a person, 2 Gets in, 3 Does the work, 4 Runs on its own, 5 Autonomous

offset.description: skip this many matches first: the next page starts at the previous answer's next_offset

pays_with.description: only products that take this way to pay: x402 or mpp (agent-native rails our drive met or the product documents) or card (a card checkout); a comma list takes any one, e.g. x402,mpp; also l402, stripe-projects, acp, ucp, ap2, mcp-payment

query.description: Name, domain or what the tool does, e.g. 'invoicing', 'stripe.com' or 'postgres'; every word must match (the same search as the directory page)

surface.description: only products that offer this way for an agent to work them: api, mcp (an MCP server), cli or sdk; a comma list wants every one, e.g. mcp,cli

name: search_tools
title: Search the directory
